thread.title: Stocks Mixed As Nike Leads Dow, GE, Apple Weigh; Bitcoin Quiet

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Stocks Mixed As Nike Leads Dow, GE, Apple Weigh; Bitcoin Quiet
text:
Stocks were mixed Friday as a potential Federal shutdown loomed. Nike ( NKE ) led the Dow, but General Electric ( GE ), IBM ( IBM ) and Apple ( AAPL ) weighed. Bitcoin was quiet.
X SPDR S&P 500 ( SPY ) held a 0.3% gain, PowerShares QQQ Trust ( QQQ ) was up 0.1% and SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ( DIA ) was fractionally lower. Small caps outperformed with iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ( IJR ) and iShares Russell 2000 ( IWM ) advancing 0.9% and 0.8%, respectively.
GE and IBM slumped about 4% each, weighing on the Dow. But Nike ran ahead 3.5% after a Wedbush Securities rating upgrade to outperform from neutral. The athletic powerhouse's stock is extended from a 57.35 cup-with-handle buy point.
Apple dipped 1% but remains above a 176.34 buy point it retook Wednesday. It's still in buy range from the entry.
Banks, gold miners and homebuilders led the upside among sector funds in the stock market today . Gold ETFs rose along with the precious metal's futures, which were up 0.6% to $1,334.50 an ounce.
Energy, telecom and semiconductors lagged. Oil plays fell as West Texas intermediate crude prices slid 0.8% to $63.43 a barrel.
VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ( SMH ) and iShares PHLX Semiconductor ( SOXX ) both edged lower despite Nvidia 's ( NVDA ) pop to a new high. Bank of America lifted its price target on the graphics chip designer to 275 from 251. Shares are near the top of a buy zone from a 218.77 entry.
Bitcoin climbed 3% to $11,627.19, according to CoinDesk , down slightly from an earlier high of $11,955.44. Bitcoin Investment Trust ( GBTC ), down less than 2%, was having a quiet day compared to its usual recent swings.
